mergedParams.userDescription: Text opacity linked to the audio, pulsing softly with the melody. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: Audio-Reactive Text: Soft Melodic Pulse Typography

prompts.prompt: Create a typokinetics preset where text elements pulse with a breathing rhythm synchronized to the audio's melodic intensity. Think of it like a music video where the text is alive - each word or phrase should have subtle opacity oscillations that match the audio's emotional flow. The text should feel like it's inhaling and exhaling with the music, with stronger melodic moments creating more pronounced pulses. Use a multi-layered approach where different text elements (titles, captions, supporting text) have different sensitivity levels to the audio - titles being most reactive, captions moderately reactive, and supporting text gently reactive. The pulsing should never make text unreadable, operating within a comfortable 0.7-1.0 opacity range with smooth easing curves that feel organic and musical.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: Use nested BaseLayout containers with 'relative w-full h-full' for the main container, then separate BaseLayout wrappers for each text layer type. Typography: Implement TextAtom components with caption data for word-level timing. Effects: Apply waveform effects in Provider mode targeting text elements by ID, using 'opacity' property with audio.intensity mapped to 0.7-1.0 range. Set sensitivity to 0.8 for titles, 0.5 for captions, 0.3 for supporting text. Use easing: 'ease-in-out' with smoothing: 0.2 for natural breathing motion. Layout: Use 'flex flex-col justify-center items-center gap-4' for vertical text stacking. Performance: Apply 'will-change-opacity' to text elements, use transform: translateZ(0) for GPU acceleration. Timing: Set effect ranges relative to parent duration, with slight offset delays (0.1s, 0.2s, 0.3s) for cascading pulse effect.

prompts.prompt: Design a kinetic typography preset inspired by club VJ visuals where text opacity reacts to different frequency bands of the audio. Picture a dark nightclub screen where text elements glow and fade based on bass hits, mid-range melodies, and high-frequency details. Each text element should be assigned to a specific frequency band - large titles react to bass (20-250Hz), body text to mids (250-4000Hz), and accent text to highs (4000-20000Hz). The opacity changes should be sharp and punchy for bass, smooth for mids, and flickering for highs. Add a subtle glow effect that intensifies with the opacity changes to create that neon club aesthetic.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'absolute inset-0 bg-black' as main container, nested BaseLayouts for frequency-grouped text. Typography: Use TextAtom with custom font like 'Inter:900:normal' for titles, 'Inter:400:normal' for body. Effects: Implement three separate waveform effects - bass effect with audio.frequency.low, threshold: 0.6, sensitivity: 1.0; mid effect with audio.frequency.mid, sensitivity: 0.7; high effect with audio.frequency.high, sensitivity: 0.9, smoothing: 0.05 for flicker. Add internal 'glow-pulse' effect preset synchronized with opacity. Style: Apply 'text-white' base with CSS filters - 'drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(255,255,255,var(--opacity)))' for glow. Layout: Use 'grid grid-cols-1 place-items-center' with 'z-10', 'z-20', 'z-30' for layering. Performance: Batch DOM updates, use CSS containment with 'contain-paint'.

prompts.prompt: Build a minimalist typokinetic preset where text opacity breathes with the audio's amplitude envelope, creating a meditative, ambient visualization. Imagine documentary-style lower thirds that fade in and out with the natural rhythm of background music. The text should have long, slow opacity transitions that follow the overall dynamics of the audio track rather than individual beats. Include support for multiple text hierarchies where primary text maintains higher base opacity (0.8-1.0) while secondary text operates in a lower range (0.4-0.8). The effect should feel subtle and professional, never distracting from the content itself.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: Single BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden' container. Typography: Implement with caption data, using TextAtom components with 'font-sans' for clean aesthetics. Effects: Use generic keyframe effects with AnimationRange[], calculate keyframes based on audio intensity data fetched via props.fetcher. Set long transition durations (2-4 seconds) between keyframes. Primary text: opacity range 0.8-1.0, secondary: 0.4-0.8. Apply 'ease-in-out' easing with additional smoothing via moving average calculation in presetExecution. Layout: Position with 'absolute bottom-0 left-0 p-8' for lower thirds, or 'flex items-center justify-center' for centered titles. Style: Use 'text-gray-100' with 'antialiased' for smooth rendering. Timing: Use fitDurationTo: 'media' to match audio duration, with effect ranges spanning full duration.

prompts.prompt: Create an energetic typokinetics preset where individual words pulse with staggered timing based on audio beats, like a lyric video where each word lights up with the rhythm. Think of classic karaoke-style presentations but with sophisticated opacity animations instead of color changes. Words should anticipate beats slightly, fading up just before the beat hits for maximum impact. Include options for different pulse styles - sharp pulses for electronic music, smooth pulses for acoustic, and bouncy pulses for pop music. The baseline opacity should be readable but subdued (0.5-0.6), pulsing to full opacity (1.0) on beats.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout wrapper with nested BaseLayouts for each caption line using childrenProps and repeatChildrenProps. Typography: Use caption.words array with word-level timing, map each word to a TextAtom with unique ID. Effects: Fetch audio beat data via props.fetcher('/api/audio/analyze'), create effect ranges aligned to beat timestamps minus 0.05s anticipation offset. Implement three pulse variations via internal effect presets: 'sharp-pulse' (0.1s duration), 'smooth-pulse' (0.3s with ease-in-out), 'bounce-pulse' (0.2s with spring easing). Layout: Use 'flex flex-wrap gap-2' for word spacing, 'justify-center' for alignment. Style: Base opacity via 'opacity-60' class, effects override to 1.0. Performance: Use React.memo equivalent patterns, limit simultaneous animations to viewport-visible words.

prompts.prompt: Develop a cinematic typokinetics preset where text opacity creates depth layers that respond to audio dynamics, similar to movie title sequences where text emerges from and recedes into darkness. Foreground text should have subtle opacity variations (0.9-1.0) while background text has dramatic swings (0.2-0.8). Create a parallax-like effect where different text layers pulse at different rates and intensities, with delays that create a wave-like propagation through the text hierarchy. The overall effect should feel epic and theatrical, suitable for trailers or dramatic content.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: Multiple BaseLayout layers with 'absolute inset-0' positioning, z-index stacking from 1-5. Typography: Large TextAtom for main title ('text-6xl font-bold'), medium for subtitle ('text-2xl font-light'), small for credits ('text-sm'). Effects: Implement cascading waveform effects with different configs per layer - foreground: sensitivity: 0.3, range: [0.9, 1.0]; midground: sensitivity: 0.6, range: [0.5, 0.9]; background: sensitivity: 1.0, range: [0.2, 0.8]. Add propagation delay using effect.delay calculated as layerIndex * 0.15. Style: Apply 'text-white mix-blend-screen' for luminous effect. Layout: Use CSS Grid with 'grid-rows-[1fr_auto_1fr]' for vertical distribution. Performance: Implement viewport-based culling, use CSS contain: layout style paint.

prompts.prompt: Design a data-driven typokinetics preset where text opacity visualizes audio metadata like sentiment and energy, perfect for music visualization or podcast transcriptions. Text should pulse based on the audio's emotional intensity - calm sections have gentle, slow pulses (0.8-0.95 opacity) while intense sections have rapid, dramatic pulses (0.3-1.0 opacity). Incorporate caption metadata (impact, keyword, sentiment scores) to modulate the pulsing intensity per word. Keywords pulse stronger, high-impact words pulse faster, and sentiment influences the pulse smoothness (positive = smooth, negative = sharp).
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full p-8' container. Typography: Process caption data with metadata analysis, create TextAtom for each word with calculated effect intensity. Effects: Build dynamic effect arrays based on metadata - impact score multiplies sensitivity (0.5-1.5x), keyword flag adds 0.2 to max opacity, sentiment affects easing (positive: 'ease-in-out', negative: 'linear', neutral: 'ease-out'). Use audio.intensity as base driver with per-word modulation. Layout: Implement 'flex flex-wrap gap-1' with 'leading-relaxed' for readability. Style: Base styles vary by sentiment - positive: 'text-green-100', negative: 'text-red-100', neutral: 'text-gray-100'. Timing: Align effects to word.timing.relative for precise synchronization.

prompts.prompt: Create a retro-futuristic typokinetics preset inspired by 80s music videos where text opacity flickers and pulses like old CRT monitors responding to synthesizer beats. The text should have a base visibility with random micro-flickers (0.9-1.0 opacity at 60fps intervals) overlaid with larger audio-driven pulses. Add scan line effects where opacity varies slightly across horizontal bands of text. Include options for different retro styles - VHS (with chromatic aberration via opacity offsets), CRT (with phosphor glow decay), and LED display (with discrete opacity steps).
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full bg-black overflow-hidden' base. Typography: Use monospace fonts like 'Courier:700:normal' or 'JetBrainsMono:500:normal'. Effects: Layer multiple effect systems - base flicker via rapid AnimationRange with Math.random() * 0.1 + 0.9 opacity at 16ms intervals; audio pulse via waveform effect with stepped easing (Math.floor(value * 10) / 10); scan lines via CSS linear-gradient masks. Style: Apply 'text-green-400' for CRT, 'text-cyan-300' for VHS, 'text-amber-400' for LED. Add text-shadow for glow: '0 0 10px currentColor'. Layout: Use 'font-mono whitespace-pre' for authentic terminal look. Performance: Throttle flicker updates to 30fps, use requestAnimationFrame scheduling.

prompts.prompt: Build an organic typokinetics preset where text opacity flows like water responding to audio waves, creating fluid, natural movements reminiscent of underwater title sequences. Text should have sinusoidal opacity variations that overlap and interfere with each other, creating complex patterns. Different text elements should oscillate at different frequencies - titles at 0.5Hz, body at 1Hz, captions at 2Hz - with the audio intensity modulating the amplitude of these oscillations. The effect should feel liquid and dreamlike, never harsh or mechanical.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full' and multiple child BaseLayouts for text layers. Typography: TextAtom components with varying sizes and weights for hierarchy. Effects: Implement sine wave modulation in presetExecution - calculate opacity as baseOpacity + Math.sin(time * frequency * 2 * Math.PI) * amplitude * audioIntensity. Use different frequencies per layer (0.5Hz, 1Hz, 2Hz). Add phase offsets for wave interference. Smooth with moving average over 5 frames. Style: Use 'text-blue-100' base with 'blur-[0.5px]' for soft edges. Apply 'mix-blend-soft-light' for ethereal blending. Layout: Position with 'absolute' and calculated top/left percentages for floating placement. Timing: Use continuous animation with time parameter, not keyframe-based.

prompts.prompt: Design a glitch-art typokinetics preset where text opacity corrupts and recovers based on audio transients, perfect for electronic music or cyberpunk aesthetics. During audio peaks, text should fragment into multiple opacity layers - some parts become transparent while others over-brighten, creating a digital corruption effect. Between peaks, text slowly recovers to normal opacity. Include datamoshing-style effects where previous opacity states briefly 'stick' before updating. The glitches should feel intentional and artistic rather than truly broken.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with multiple duplicate TextAtom layers offset by 1-2px. Typography: Use same text content across layers with different opacity treatments. Effects: Detect transients via audio analysis (intensity spike > 0.8), trigger glitch sequences - randomly assign opacity 0, 0.3, 0.7, or 1.2 (via CSS filter brightness) to different layers. Implement 'sticky' frames by delaying opacity updates by 50-100ms randomly. Recovery uses exponential decay back to 1.0 over 500ms. Style: Base 'text-white', glitch layers use 'text-red-500', 'text-green-500', 'text-blue-500' with 'mix-blend-difference'. Layout: Stack with 'absolute inset-0' positioning, slight transforms 'translate-x-[1px]' for offset. Performance: Pool and reuse glitch effect objects, limit to 3 simultaneous glitches.

prompts.prompt: Create an adaptive typokinetics preset that intelligently adjusts text opacity pulsing based on the musical genre and tempo detected in the audio, like an AI DJ that knows how to match visuals to music style. For slow ballads, use long, gentle opacity swells (0.7-1.0 over 2-3 seconds). For EDM, use sharp, beat-synchronized pulses (0.3-1.0 in 100ms). For jazz, use syncopated, off-beat opacity variations. The system should analyze the audio characteristics in real-time and smoothly transition between pulsing styles when the music changes.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with dynamic effect injection based on audio analysis results. Typography: TextAtom with consistent structure, effects change programmatically. Effects: Implement genre detection via audio frequency analysis - low bass prominence = EDM, complex harmonics = jazz, steady tempo = pop. Create effect preset library: 'ballad-pulse', 'edm-pulse', 'jazz-pulse', 'rock-pulse'. Use crossfading between effect styles over 1-second transitions when genre changes. Calculate tempo via beat detection, adjust effect duration inversely (60/BPM seconds). Style: Maintain consistent 'text-white' base, only opacity changes. Layout: Use 'flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-6' for clean presentation. Performance: Cache genre detection results, update every 2 seconds to prevent jitter. Timing: Use fitDurationTo: 'audio' with dynamic effect range recalculation.
